"""Extract 3 groups of qualitative case study examples for appendix."""
import json

# === Load data ===

sft_preds = json.load(open(SFT_PRED_PATH))
rsft_preds = json.load(open(RSFT_PRED_PATH))

# Build doc_id -> dev_data index
dev_by_title = {}
for doc in dev_data:
    dev_by_title[doc["title"]] = doc

# Build prediction dicts indexed by doc_id
sft_by_doc = {p["doc_id"]: p for p in sft_preds}
rsft_by_doc = {p["doc_id"]: p for p in rsft_preds}

def get_doc_text(doc):
    """Get full document text with sentence boundaries."""
    sents = [" ".join(s) for s in doc["sents"]]
    return sents

def get_doc_text_preview(doc, max_chars=300):
    sents = get_doc_text(doc)
    text = " ".join(sents)
    return text[:max_chars] + ("..." if len(text) > max_chars else "")

def triple_key(t):
    return (t["head"].lower().strip(), t["tail"].lower().strip(), t["relation"].lower().strip())

def evidence_precision(pred_evi, gold_evi):
    """Fraction of predicted evidence that is in gold."""
    if not pred_evi:
        return 0.0
    pred_set = set(pred_evi)
    gold_set = set(gold_evi)
    hits = pred_set & gold_set
    return len(hits) / len(pred_set)

def evidence_recall(pred_evi, gold_evi):
    if not gold_evi:
        return 1.0
    pred_set = set(pred_evi)
    gold_set = set(gold_evi)
    hits = pred_set & gold_set
    return len(hits) / len(gold_set)

# =====================================================================
# GROUP 1: RSFT vs SFT evidence quality contrast
# =====================================================================
print("\n=== GROUP 1: RSFT vs SFT evidence quality ===")

group1_candidates = []

for doc_id in sft_by_doc:
    if doc_id not in rsft_by_doc:
        continue
    
    sft_doc = sft_by_doc[doc_id]
    rsft_doc = rsft_by_doc[doc_id]
    
    # Build gold triple -> evidence mapping
    gold_map = {}
    for gt in sft_doc.get("gold_triples", []):
        key = triple_key(gt)
        gold_map[key] = gt.get("evidence", [])
    
    # Build SFT and RSFT triple -> evidence mappings
    sft_triple_map = {}
    for pt in sft_doc.get("parsed_triples", []):
        key = triple_key(pt)
        if key not in sft_triple_map:  # keep first occurrence
            sft_triple_map[key] = pt.get("evidence", [])
    
    rsft_triple_map = {}
    for pt in rsft_doc.get("parsed_triples", []):
        key = triple_key(pt)
        if key not in rsft_triple_map:
            rsft_triple_map[key] = pt.get("evidence", [])
    
    # Find triples where BOTH SFT and RSFT correctly predicted (match gold)
    for gold_key, gold_evi in gold_map.items():
        if gold_key in sft_triple_map and gold_key in rsft_triple_map:
            sft_evi = sft_triple_map[gold_key]
            rsft_evi = rsft_triple_map[gold_key]
            
            if not gold_evi or not sft_evi or not rsft_evi:
                continue
            
            sft_prec = evidence_precision(sft_evi, gold_evi)
            rsft_prec = evidence_precision(rsft_evi, gold_evi)
            sft_rec = evidence_recall(sft_evi, gold_evi)
            rsft_rec = evidence_recall(rsft_evi, gold_evi)
            
            # We want cases where RSFT evidence is much better than SFT
            prec_diff = rsft_prec - sft_prec
            
            if prec_diff > 0.3 and rsft_prec >= 0.8:
                group1_candidates.append({
                    "doc_id": doc_id,

    print(f"      SFT evi={item['sft_evidence']} (prec={item['sft_evi_precision']:.2f})")
    print(f"      RSFT evi={item['rsft_evidence']} (prec={item['rsft_evi_precision']:.2f})")
    print(f"      Gold evi={item['gold_evidence']}")

# =====================================================================
